The Class 8 truck market is expected to recover by 8-10% in FY2026-27, following the sharp decline in FY2025-26.
Growth & demand: For FY2026-27, Passenger Vehicle (PV) demand is expected to grow in the range of ~4-6%, while MHCV growth is likely to improve to 3-5%, supported by infrastructure spending and replacement demand.
Global growth is expected to remain subdued but stable, with GDP growth projected at ~3.0-3.2% (source IMF), amid tight financial conditions, ongoing geopolitical tensions, and trade uncertainties.
The heavy commercial vehicle segment (>16T) is expected to stabilize with low single-digit growth (~1-3%), following a weak demand phase.
